Using the corrected critical point:
\[
n \approx \frac{2}{\ln 1.001} \approx 2001.
\]
Now compare neighboring integers:

\[
\frac{f(2001)}{f(2000)}
=\frac{(2001/2000)^2}{1.001}
=\frac{1.00100025}{1.001}>1,
\]
so \(f(2001)>f(2000)\).

\[
\frac{f(2002)}{f(2001)}
=\frac{(2002/2001)^2}{1.001}
<1,
\]
so \(f(2002)<f(2001)\).

Thus the maximum occurs at \(n=2001\).

\[
\boxed{2001}
\]
